purpose: Define the causal experimental atom surrounding the frozen Layer-0 phenomenon probe.
trial_atom: tau = (X0, C, e, B, Theta, E_spec) -> I -> A(I,E)

identity.observation_hash: SHA-256(canonical TrialSpec + raw_model_output + derived evaluation record)

custody.raw_model_output: primary outcome custody object; never human-rewritten

controls.ordering: trial records may be executed in arbitrary order; cell identity is explicit
controls.replication: set prospectively by execution manifest; not inferred from observed output
controls.evaluator: fixed exogenous evaluator specification bound into TrialSpec

negative_controls.C1: matched non-frame control for v0.1; no mechanism hypothesis, exemplar, or alternative-path information
negative_controls.future: placebo/salience control is reserved for a later preregistered extension and does not alter this baseline

analysis_boundary.derived: parser/evaluator results and distribution estimates are derived after raw capture
analysis_boundary.secondary: distribution-valued context-by-intervention interaction and descriptive validity/implementation frequencies

claim_ceiling: This artifact establishes an auditable experimental unit and assignment/custody semantics; it makes no claim that the Layer-0 phenomenon exists.
